audio.processingRecording: Processing your recording... This may take up to 1 minute.

troubleshooting.properlyConnected: Ensure your microphone is properly connected.
troubleshooting.checkPermissions: Check browser permissions for microphone access.

errors.sessionInUse: This recording is open in another tab or window.
errors.pauseNotSaved: Paused, but part of the recording could not be saved. Don't close the app yet: finish the recording to keep what was saved, or check the abandoned recordings.
errors.sessionNotResumable: This recording was already finished and is only kept as a backup; it cannot be continued.
errors.resumeNeedsStore: Stored recordings can only be continued when the default storage is enabled.
errors.inputUnavailable: The audio input is not available right now (e.g. during a call). The recording stays paused; try again later.

warnings.suspendedRecording: Recording was interrupted while in background. Some audio may be missing.

audio.pausedSafely: Everything so far is saved. You can close the app and continue later.
audio.pausedByInterruption: Paused because another app (e.g. a call) took the microphone. Everything so far is saved.
audio.savingPause: Saving what was recorded so far…
